transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been feeling like I’ve let my family down, especially taking on this mortgage. And then if I make even a small mistake at work, it just feels like proof that I’m useless… like I deserve whatever happens to me.
How long have you been feeling this way—weeks, months, or longer?
About a year and eight months now—since I took on the condo mortgage.

Since this started about 20 months ago, has this low, self-critical mood been present almost every day continuously, or has it come and gone in separate episodes with periods where you felt more like your normal self in between?
For most of that time, it’s been there more often than not. Some days are a little lighter, but I still feel that empty, guilty weight hanging over me.

During this almost two-year period, has there been any specific stretch of at least two weeks where your mood or other symptoms got noticeably worse—like major changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, or thoughts of death—compared to your usual baseline?
I’m not really sure. It’s mostly felt like the same heavy feeling for a long time, rather than a clearly worse stretch.

Have you ever, at any point during these past 20 months, gone through a stretch of two weeks or more where you felt so low that you had trouble getting out of bed, lost interest in almost everything, or had thoughts that life wasn't worth living?
Yeah… I’d say the really depressed, guilty part has lasted about a year and two months altogether.
During that year-and-two-month stretch, did you lose interest or pleasure in almost everything you used to enjoy, nearly every day?

Yeah, pretty much. I used to joke around with the regulars and text my brother after work, but now I mostly keep a straight face, say what I need to say, and let messages sit. I just don’t feel much pull to do those things.
During that year-and-two-month period, did you notice significant changes in your sleep—like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual—nearly every day?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid close attention to my sleep enough to say it changed nearly every day.
During that year-and-two-month period, did you notice a significant change in your appetite or weight—either eating much more or much less than usual—nearly every day?
Yeah. My eating’s been pretty all over the place—some weeks I barely touch the staff meal, and then other nights I’ll come home and eat whatever’s in the kitchen just to feel settled.
During that year-and-two-month period of feeling this way, was there ever a stretch of two months or longer where these symptoms went away and you felt back to your normal self?
No, I don’t think so. Even when I had lighter days, that empty, guilty feeling was there more often than not through most of it.
